notes: Fixed Spending insights missing purchases paid through a payment app: a subscription paid with PayPal ("PAYPAL *NETFLIX") used to count as a transfer between your own accounts, so it vanished from your spending total and from the subscriptions list — it now shows as Netflix, with its yearly cost. Purchases through Square, Toast, Clover, DoorDash and PayPal ("SQ *STARBUCKS", "TST*CHIPOTLE") also used to invent fake stores ("Sq", "Tst") and split one real store across two entries in Top places — the real store name is used now. Plain transfers (Transfer to savings, Venmo to a person, PayPal transfer to bank) are still left out of spending.
